And the country has been eviscerated and essentially is really no longer a threat.

Trump’s speech was strange, low energy, and completely devoid of any real purpose. He regurgitated the same lies he’s been pushing about the war, offered zero clarity, and sounded unhinged. He openly threatened what amount to war crimes, casually suggested the Strait would just open up on its own, and slurred his way through the remarks. It’s unclear who that speech was even meant to persuade.

On cue, Iran is now calling Trump out for lying.

Here’s what happened: Trump likely saw a tweet like this from First Squawk hit the wire — an out of context statement from Iran’s president. When you look at the context, and his past statements, it’s clear this is just the same thing he has been saying all along.
Trump’s post is also, unsurprisingly, a lie. This never happened.
